subject: Behavioral Economics
title: The Possibility Effect
description: A 60-second lesson on The Possibility Effect.

hook.text: Going from 0% to 5% feels enormous. Going from 5% to 10% feels small. We overweight the jump from impossible.

buildup.text: The possibility effect: a small chance of something great (or terrible) captivates attention beyond its probability.

discovery.text: This effect drives both lottery dreams and terrorism fears. A tiny chance of extreme outcomes warps decisions.

twist.text: Insurance companies profit from this. We overpay to protect against rare catastrophes because we overweight them.

climax.text: The possibility and certainty effects are two sides of the same coin: we warp probabilities near the extremes.

punchline.text: Possible and probable feel the same. They're not.

quiz.question: What does the possibility effect cause?
options: We overweight the jump from impossible to possible
